library.evidence: Inline Library JavaScript contained a broken authors fallback string in the table renderer.
Metadata enrichment output contained broken old/new fallback string literals.

search.evidence: Search page did not render a deterministic 429/HTTP failure state before this hotfix.

deep_research.evidence: Docker Compose defaulted DEEP_RESEARCH_ENABLED to false even when the production DeepSeek provider was otherwise configured.
Deep Research inline JavaScript emitted Python-decoded newlines inside a quoted JavaScript string and had a broken localized validation message.

shared.evidence: Route availability tests passed while browser-executable JavaScript could still fail.
All non-health/capability routes used a single Redis rate bucket and request.client.host, so Nginx traffic collapsed to the proxy IP.

fixes.javascript_gate: scripts/check_ui_javascript_syntax_v1.py extracts FastAPI UI scripts and validates them with node --check.

rate_limit.trusted_proxy_header_policy: X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP are accepted only when request.client.host is inside TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS.

fixes.capabilities: Added explicit deep_research capability with provider/model/template_fallback/configuration detail.
fixes.docker_compose: DEEP_RESEARCH_ENABLED now defaults to true in Compose while provider and live-call configuration still fail closed when missing.

browser_smoke.reason: Playwright is not installed in the current workspace.
